title: Studio in Alliance Privilege
description: Studio apartment for sale in Alliance Privilege. Address: 42 Rustaveli Ave., Batumi. 30 m², 13th floor. Elite residential complex managed by McInerney Hospitality International — Marriott International partner. Unique location on Batumi Boulevard: near the dolphinarium, park with lake, beach and Old Town. Premium infrastructure to Marriott International standards: seawater pool, SPA complex, fitness centre, restaurants and cafés, the region's largest casino, two-level underground parking for 120 spaces, children's entertainment centre, conference and event spaces, reception, concierge, security, video surveillance. Ideal for living and investment. Superb design and renovation with furniture and appliances; bright, dry and warm apartment; panoramic sea and city view towards Turkey. Confirm current price and deal terms with your manager.
